title: Why Roller Coasters Don't Fly Off The Tracks
frame_convention: Blender frame 1 is t=0.0 s; frame_end=1887 is t=62.866… s.

shots.beat: He bent the roller coaster's loop out of shape.
shots.action: Builder grips the track; the round loop visibly warps under his hands.

shots.beat: You see, it's the first ride ever to go upside down,
shots.action: A tiny cart traces a loop silhouette while the builder watches, amazed.

shots.beat: and it cost him everything.
shots.action: Builder looks down at an empty coin purse beside his failed prototype.

shots.beat: So of course, his rival copies it bolt for bolt.
shots.action: Rival measures the prototype, then lays matching iron pieces on a bench.

shots.beat: But the night before opening,
shots.action: The workshop clock hand advances; the rival's loop looms in shadow.

shots.beat: his test dummy comes back crushed like a soda can,
shots.action: The test dummy compresses into a squat accordion shape under the cart.

shots.beat: but he can't miss the opening,
shots.action: Builder glances from the dummy toward the fairground gate in the distance.

shots.beat: so he grabs a hammer and beats the bottom
shots.action: Builder clasps both hammer grips and swings; the iron rings and sparks.

shots.beat: into a long, lazy curve.
shots.action: The loop bottom spreads into a smooth broad curve as hammer stroke finishes.

shots.beat: Does he know what he's doing? Not really.
shots.action: Builder gives a sheepish shrug, then checks the improvised loop.

shots.beat: His rival laughs, then sneaks in,
shots.action: Rival suppresses a laugh and creeps toward the clamping rig.

shots.beat: and cranks the sides together until the loop is tall and skinny.
shots.action: Rival grips the crank and ratchets both loop sides inward.

shots.beat: So the first cart will snap like a twig.
shots.action: The tall narrow loop flexes ominously as a loose rail bolt falls.

shots.beat: The next morning, the town lines up at the rival's perfect circle,
shots.action: A cheerful crowd queues beside the rival's circular loop and striped booth.

shots.beat: and the rival climbs in front to show off.
shots.action: Rival steps into the lead cart and proudly gestures to spectators.

shots.beat: The owner climbs into his,
shots.action: Builder settles into his patched cart on the neighboring track.

shots.beat: and as his cart tips over the first hill,
shots.action: Builder's cart crests and tips forward; wheels pick up speed.

shots.beat: he finally sees the tall, skinny loop ahead.
shots.action: From the cart, the squeezed loop rises like a narrow gate ahead.

shots.beat: But it's too late.
shots.action: Builder's eyes widen; the track rushes into the foreground.

shots.beat: You see, a car can creep around a hairpin turn at five,
shots.action: A tiny roadster creeps around a wide, low hairpin analogy beside the track.

shots.beat: but take it at 60, and it flips.
shots.action: The little roadster flips safely onto soft straw; a visual analogy, not a crash.

shots.beat: A cart is fastest at the bottom of a loop,
shots.action: The coaster cart streaks through the lowest point; wheel blur and ties streak by.

shots.beat: and a perfect circle puts a hairpin right there,
shots.action: A clean graphic-like circular track profile emphasizes the tight bottom bend.

shots.beat: which is what crushed the dummy.
shots.action: Cut to the compressed test dummy, then snap back to the rival's circular loop.

shots.beat: But his hammer made the bottom gentle,
shots.action: The builder's broad, re-shaped lower loop smoothly eases the cart around.

shots.beat: and the rival's squeeze moved the hairpin up top,
shots.action: The rival's tall skinny loop carries its sharper curvature toward the crown.

shots.beat: where the cart is crawling.
shots.action: Cart crawls at the top of the loop, nearly weightless for a beat.

shots.beat: So he floats over without a scratch.
shots.action: Builder's cart clears the loop; he lands upright and waves in relief.

shots.beat: Just as the rival's cart hits the bottom of that perfect circle.
shots.action: Rival's cart slams through the bottom of the circular loop; end on the builder's calm look.
